_comment: Read by EtabsX on launch to tell the user a newer build exists. Update 'built' and 'version' when you publish a release; 'built' must match the BUILT line Release.py writes into build_info.py. Release.py prints this block ready to paste.
notes: Every tab now scrolls on smaller screens, output panes are read-only with scrollbars, and new versions are announced with a banner that says what changed.
